title: F.P. Journe Elegante 48 Titalyt 1-Minute Watch Review
description:

The F.P. Journe Elegante quartz watch, features a 48mm x 40mm titalyt case surrounding a black dial on a green rubber strap outfitted with a titalyt and titanium deployant buckle. Functions include hours, minutes and seconds. This watch comes with the original box and papers. This F.P. Journe watch also measures 7.7mm in thickness and 48.1mm from lug-to-lug.
